plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run for threshold development.
More varied session types (long, aerobic, tempo) target different aspects of fitness.
plan_b_advantages: Focuses specifically on trail running with trail runs as workouts.
Simpler and potentially easier to adhere to due to its straightforward structure.
reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster because it incorporates a more structured approach to building aerobic capacity and introducing speed work. It includes a dedicated tempo run and utilizes cross-training to manage impact, crucial for trail running. Plan B, while providing consistent aerobic volume, lacks specific efforts to improve speed and threshold, which are key components of becoming a faster runner. The longer, consistent aerobic runs in Plan B could lead to plateaus without targeted intensity work.
